create_partitioner: create a PjitPartitioner to partition JAX model computations across TPU or GPU devices with configurable parallelism
build_mesh: build a JAX Mesh for data and model parallelism from hardware device bounds and a model-parallel submesh specification
get_logical_axes: get logical axis names from a TrainState using partitioner-configured logical-to-mesh axis rules
get_mesh_axes: get PartitionSpec mesh axis resources from a TrainState by mapping logical axes through partitioning rules
partition_function: partition a Python function with jax.pjit using specified input and output axis resource sharding specs
